name: SMART Goals
excerpt: SMART Goals are specific, measurable, attainable, results-oriented, and time-bound.
notes: SMART Goals involve objectives that are jointly established, monitored, and linked to rewards. They are flexible and progress is periodically reviewed.
context_summary:
- Specific and measurable objectives
- Attainable and results-oriented
- Time-bound deadlines
- Jointly established and monitored
- Linked to rewards and flexible
- Progress is periodically reviewed
